design.selection: all 28 category queries: Category P@10, then Hit@10, then smaller lexical fraction w_l/(w_d+w_l)
design.remaining_exact_ties: report co-winners; use family order only to display one representative, no extra trials
design.normalization: per query and leg over up to 50 report candidates; (score-min)/(max-min); constant-score leg maps to 0; absent report contributes 0
design.zero_weight: exclude zero-weight leg entirely; pure-leg endpoints preserve that leg's exact ranking and evidence
design.cache_policy: reuse complete Step 6 report candidates when available; existing top-ten-only cache preserved and verified against one full-depth recapture; sweep itself is pure reranking
design.layer2: Step 6 judged-only condensed protocol on runtime qrels; coverage beside each signal; never used for selection
design.boundary: report endpoint wins without extending grid

recommendation: Recommend adopting weighted_rrf 10:1 as the flagship default under the fixed primary selection rule: Category P@10 improves by +0.0143 on this development set. Adoption remains a separate decision.
concentration_note: Although 8/28 queries improve and 5/28 worsen, the net gain is only 4 matching reports. The two largest positive flips (equip-l2-2, ri-l1-2) contribute 4 matches; excluding those queries leaves +0 net matches. The overall win therefore does rest on two query flips in aggregate; it is a fragile development margin, not broad evidence of superiority.
